2026-11-08 06:55:08.702771 | controller | The unit files have no installation config (WantedBy=, RequiredBy=, UpheldBy=,
2026-11-08 06:55:08.702802 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-11-08 06:55:08.703378 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-11-08 06:55:08.703386 | controller |
2026-11-08 06:55:08.703399 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-08 06:55:08.703413 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-11-08 06:55:08.703425 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-08 06:55:08.703430 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-08 06:55:08.703448 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-08 06:55:08.703466 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-11-08 06:55:08.703477 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
